project_title: Prestine Pacific EMS - Operational Web Dashboard Strategy & Design System
core_design_objective: Eliminate operator ambiguity by strictly categorizing UI states into four distinct visual buckets: Live Active Telemetry, Configuration Discrepancies, Historical References, and Legacy Logs. Preserve truthful UNKNOWN, NOT VERIFIED, and UNAVAILABLE states without visual clutter.

category_1_live_active.name: Live Active Telemetry
category_1_live_active.visual_language: Glowing Emerald pulse indicators, solid 1px emerald borders (#10B981), high-contrast primary typography.
applied_to: Active Wing States (Wing A, B, C Active/Enabled)

category_2_config_gaps.name: Configuration Discrepancies & Unverified States
category_2_config_gaps.visual_language: Amber/Orange warning banners (#F59E0B), diagonal stripe borders, pill labels 'CONFIG GAP', truthful UNKNOWN displays.
applied_to: Energy Config Version (Desired v2.1 vs Reported UNKNOWN)

category_3_historical_references.name: Historical References & Baselines
category_3_historical_references.visual_language: Steel Indigo/Slate card containers (#6366F1), dashed or subtle borders, mandatory badge 'HISTORICAL REFERENCE • NO DIRECT EXPORT CLAIM'.
applied_to: Monthly Generation Bar Charts & M1 Generation

category_4_legacy_past_failures.name: Historical Past Event / Legacy Log
category_4_legacy_past_failures.visual_language: De-emphasized Muted Dark Gray (#64748B), outline-only style, distinct dated badge 'HISTORICAL EVENT (Sep 14)' to prevent misinterpreting as a current active fault.
applied_to: Old LCD#40 failed DISPLAY_UNAVAILABLE dated Sep 14

typography.headline_font: Cabinet Grotesk or Barlow Condensed or Chivo (FORBIDDEN: Space Grotesk)
typography.telemetry_mono_font: JetBrains Mono or IBM Plex Mono

grids_and_layouts.layout_mode: MODE B: High Density Bento Grid (Analytics & Control Command Center)
grids_and_layouts.container_structure: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-5 p-4 md:p-6 max-w-[1600px] mx-auto

visual_enhancers.unknown_badge: inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-md text-xs font-mono font-medium border border-dashed border-sky-500/40 bg-sky-950/30 text-sky-300

component_map.DashboardHeader.tsx: Header displaying Prestine Pacific, Mumbai controller identity, live connection badge (ONLINE • 22s ago), and controller device selector dropdown.
component_map.StatusStrip.tsx: Top-level health summary: CPU/Uptime/Boot watchdog state (truthful UNKNOWN), Storage health (active SMART UNAVAILABLE warning), and Config Version Convergence (Desired v2.1 vs Reported UNKNOWN).
component_map.WingEnergyCard.tsx: Per-Wing billing & status card. Wings A, B, C enabled with bill refs (A: 312.73, B: 36.33, C: 77.03). Wing D disabled with explicit 'EXCLUDED FROM AGGREGATE' visual shield.
component_map.EnergyPanel.tsx: Aggregate consumption display (426.10 kWh) with strict exclusion of disabled Wing D, accompanied by Historical Baseline Comparison (402.32 kWh) and Pi-day comparison controls.
component_map.GenerationCard.tsx: Manual vs AUTO calculation selector, M1 physical generation inputs, monthly generation plot, and selected calendar context.
component_map.LcdMessagePanel.tsx: Retained 20x4 LCD web message preview screen with live physical character grid simulation and payload update controls.
component_map.SystemControls.tsx: System action triggers (Reboot, OTA, Config Sync) with modal confirmations and strict read-only member protection disabling writes.
component_map.OperationalLogs.tsx: Bounded operational log with state filters (All, Active Faults, Config Discrepancies, Historical Legacy) and 'Show More' history expansion.

accessibility.contrast_ratio: APCA & WCAG AA minimum 4.5:1 for standard text, 3:1 for large metrics
accessibility.data_testid_rule: MUST add data-testid on every interactive button, input, toggle, tab, metric card, and badge (e.g., data-testid='society-sync-status-badge', data-testid='wing-a-bill-input').
accessibility.reduced_motion: Wrap non-essential transitions in motion-safe: classes.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do not use generic centered layouts or unstyled default cards.
Maintain strict data integrity: UNKNOWN and NOT VERIFIED states must be visually distinct and truthful, not converted to 0 or hidden.
Ensure Wing D (disabled) is clearly labeled as logically excluded from the society aggregate calculation (426.10 kWh).
Separate current active storage warnings (SMART UNAVAILABLE) from historical old fault logs (Sep 14 LCD failure) using clear category tags.
All interactive and key informational components must include explicit kebab-case data-testid attributes.
Never use Space Grotesk font for this dashboard. Use Cabinet Grotesk or Barlow Condensed for headings and JetBrains Mono for metrics.
instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the UI enhancements across existing files (/app/frontend/src/components/ops/*.tsx) according to these specifications. Maintain existing backend API hooks and identity/permission rules while upgrading layout structure, color cues, spacing, and data hierarchy.
